gathering_routes.name: Tower Ruin Edge
gathering_routes.description: The strip between the tower's own wall and the open plains, where the fallen stone stops and the grass starts. Everything here grows in the seam: too rough for the beds, too sheltered for the crossing.

gathering_routes.name: Plains Crossing
gathering_routes.description: An open plains crossroads shaped by field roads, low grass obstacles, and bright verges that read clearly even in the first spring pass.

gathering_routes.name: Stone Quarry
gathering_routes.description: A broken quarry lane with choke points, shelf cuts, and mineral scars where catalyst residue and stone-fed growth collect.

gathering_routes.name: Creekside Meadow
gathering_routes.description: The verge and the inner footpaths, used as a crossroads rather than a gathering lane. What comes up is whatever survives being walked past four hundred times a day.

gathering_routes.name: Moonlit Grove
gathering_routes.description: The first winding path in from the plains, with breaks in the canopy that let a little sky down. Everything worth taking here waits for those gaps.

gathering_routes.name: Charred Hollow
gathering_routes.description: The burn. Nothing has closed the canopy back over it in twenty years, so it is the one floor in the valley that still gets light in winter — and very nearly the only ground worth walking once the rest has shut down.

gathering_routes.name: Lake Shallows
gathering_routes.description: A curved shoreline route with reed beds, cool coves, and shallow-water edges that favor early moisture gathers.

gathering_routes.name: Sunscar Dunes
gathering_routes.description: A dune-lane approach cut by exposed stone scars and sparse shelter pockets where heat-touched growth survives.

gathering_routes.name: Rainmist Canopy
gathering_routes.description: Root arches, standing clearings and a canopy that holds the rain long after it has stopped falling. The mist under it is not weather, it is the ceiling draining, and it keeps going on days the sky is clear.

gathering_routes.name: Greenhouse Walk
gathering_routes.description: A short cultivated loop under glass, laid out by somebody who expected to be back. Close enough to work in one pass, far enough apart that nothing shades anything else.

gathering_routes.name: Containment Ring
gathering_routes.description: The cell walk, habitat frames on both sides and the floor kept deliberately dull. The point of the room is that nothing in it is interested in you.

gathering_routes.name: Archive Stack
gathering_routes.description: Shelf ends and the run of bindings along the north wall. Ione permits gathering on exactly her terms, and what the room gives up is what it was losing anyway.

gathering_routes.name: Observatory Span
gathering_routes.description: The rim walk around the great lens, above the weather. On a clear night the mirror gives its heat to the sky and takes nothing back, so what is collected here was left rather than grown.

gathering_routes.name: Sunscar Salt Pan
gathering_routes.description: The cracked pan below the dunes. Worth nothing at all at noon and worth the whole trip after dark or after rain, which is the one lesson the desert teaches everybody exactly once.

gathering_routes.name: Town Bed Rows
gathering_routes.description: The strips of worked ground behind the square. Bare for a decade, and worth walking again once Rowan has the row turned.

gathering_routes.name: Rune Bench Row
gathering_routes.description: The working length of the workshop: channelled benches, spent chalk, and frames that have been shedding their own inlay since long before anyone came back.

gathering_routes.name: Quarry Sump
gathering_routes.description: The bottom of the workings, where the cut faces and the standing water are. Worth nothing at all in a dry week and worth the walk the morning after rain.

gathering_routes.name: Hedgerow Line
gathering_routes.description: The field boundary and the open meadow beside it. Both only give anything up while the wind is blowing, which is the one thing about the plains nobody thinks to tell a newcomer.

gathering_routes.name: Pass Switchback
gathering_routes.description: The cut road climbing out of the valley, above the cloud line more often than not, and the only ground in reach that belongs to somewhere else.

gathering_routes.name: Lake Strandline
gathering_routes.description: The bare line the water leaves overnight, walked before the sun reaches it. Weed off the inflow, glass off the tower, a bloom that is new. Nothing on this line grew where you are standing.

gathering_routes.name: The Drip Line
gathering_routes.description: A pace out from the big trunks, where the canopy lets go of what it caught. It rains here for hours after it has stopped raining above, and on a clear morning this is the only wet ground in the valley.

gathering_routes.name: The Upper Bank
gathering_routes.description: The bank that lay across the switchback a season ago is now the only south-facing soil above the treeline. Flower early in the year, thrift through the heat, lichen once the cold is properly in.

gathering_routes.name: The Settled Roost
gathering_routes.description: Nothing here can be worked in daylight, and for twenty years nothing here could be worked at all. After dark and in still air the roost comes down and stays down, which is the whole of the opportunity.

gathering_routes.name: The Seed Year
gathering_routes.description: The far end of the hedgerow, walked in autumn for the first time in twenty years with any reason to. The crowns are the same crowns. What is different is that they are carrying, and you can hear it from thirty feet.

gathering_routes.name: The Clear Shelf
gathering_routes.description: The shallow shelf off the reed bar, which used to be a grey plate you took on trust and is now a floor with things growing on it. Nobody dredged it. It settled, the way water does when whatever held it up stops.
